{
  "settings": [
    {"name": "mysql_bit1_as_boolean", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to convert `BIT(1)` columns to `BOOLEAN`", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "true", "default_evidence": "`true`"},
    {"name": "mysql_debug_show_queries", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "DEBUG SETTING: print all queries sent to MySQL to stdout", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "`false`"},
    {"name": "mysql_enable_filter_pushdown", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to use filter pushdown (without predicate analyzer)", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "true", "default_evidence": "`true`"},
    {"name": "mysql_enable_transactions", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether to run `START TRANSACTION` / `COMMIT` / `ROLLBACK` on MySQL connections", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "true", "default_evidence": "`true`"},
    {"name": "mysql_incomplete_dates_as_nulls", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether to return `DATE`s with a zero month or day as `NULL`s", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "`false`"},
    {"name": "mysql_pool_acquire_mode", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "How to acquire connections from the pool: `force` (always connect, ignoring the pool limit), `wait` (block until one is available), or `try` (fail immediately if none is available)", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "force", "default_evidence": "`force`"},
    {"name": "mysql_pool_connection_idle_timeout_millis", "input_type": "BIGINT", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Maximum time in milliseconds a connection can sit idle in the cache before being closed", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "60000", "default_evidence": "`60000`"},
    {"name": "mysql_pool_connection_max_lifetime_millis", "input_type": "BIGINT", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Maximum age in milliseconds of a pooled connection since it was first opened; when exceeded, the connection is closed instead of being returned to the cache (`0` disables it)", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "0", "default_evidence": "`0`"},
    {"name": "mysql_pool_enable_reaper_thread", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether to run a dedicated thread that periodically scans the pool and removes expired connections", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "true", "default_evidence": "`true`"},
    {"name": "mysql_pool_enable_thread_local_cache", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Enable thread-local connection caching for faster same-thread connection reuse", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "`false`"},
    {"name": "mysql_pool_size", "input_type": "BIGINT", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Maximum number of connections per MySQL catalog", "default_kind": "machine_dependent", "default_value": "automatic (based on the CPU count)", "default_evidence": "automatic (based on the CPU count)"},
    {"name": "mysql_pool_wait_timeout_millis", "input_type": "BIGINT", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Timeout in milliseconds when waiting for a connection from the pool", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "30000", "default_evidence": "`30000`"},
    {"name": "mysql_session_time_zone", "input_type": "VARCHAR", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Session time zone to set for newly opened connections to the MySQL server", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "''", "default_evidence": "`''`"},
    {"name": "mysql_time_as_time", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to convert MySQL's `TIME` columns to DuckDB's `TIME`", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "false", "default_evidence": "`false`"},
    {"name": "mysql_tinyint1_as_boolean", "input_type": "BOOLEAN", "scope": "GLOBAL", "evidence": "Whether or not to convert `TINYINT(1)` columns to `BOOLEAN`", "default_kind": "literal", "default_value": "true", "default_evidence": "`true`"}
  ]
}
